notes: The leaf is a continuation beginning des (phi_i), with source page number 6 at bottom left and no visible date or title. The lowest writing reaches the physical scan edge; missing strokes beyond that edge are not reconstructed.

The original and both supplied native overlapping halves were personally inspected once, including every token and every C/H agreement. Fourteen one-place crops were made and personally inspected once each. The fourteenth addressed a previously uncovered punctuation question after i in I. Root independently inspected and adjudicated all fourteen. This reader did not revisit any original, half or crop.

The top phrase and l’extension use two high quotation ticks, not guillemets. The opening quote of l’extension precedes l’, placing the article inside. No detached acute occurs over the first e of definie; both witnesses’ accented spelling is left unnormalized in the final.
The (16) et (18) insertion has a separate curved attachment with a descending left foot before de. The reference words agree in C/H; the graphic records actual omitted geometry.

The second argument of (19) is overworked. T, parentheses and bar are clear; the Q-like oval coexists with a long low-left stroke, dark dot and short right stroke. The whole cluster is reproduced with doubt, without choosing a clean Q, a prior phi/index form, or a deletion chronology. H’s explicit note acknowledges its uncertainty; no duplicate H omission is charged for that.

Supposons and X are cancelled. A long rightward loop lies between cancelling horizontals; it may be a cancellation return or a surviving trace. The graphic is retained without inventing another word or a prime. The cancelled cluster after normalisé de is above the live X. An underlying tilde is plausible but uncertain; no deleted second X is supplied.

Separate hat, tilde and prime occur on the normalization object. The un-hatted tilde-X-prime in (20), (21) and the fibers is retained. TeX accent-brace prime placement and plain/fraktur X font choices alone are not treated as substantive changes.
The points paragraph has l’ens without a point, struck génériques, live raised maximaux and literal des D. No grammatical correction to de is made. D=sum D_i is retained as the written sum.

The (20) connector is a shaft with a rounded upward terminal, not a bare minus or completed arrowhead. The cancelled group has a G-like body and low X, with its possible prime tangled in the cancellation. The live following E and X-prime index are readable.

M0649 has qui transporte de/la structure), with de favored by the compact low loop and tail. No opening parenthesis precedes qui. Pour i in I) soit likewise has a literal unmatched closing parenthesis, not H’s comma; the (20) reference and its following period remain.

M0650 is a literal doubtful graphic: its dark knot/loop, upper return, short rise and long low stroke admit on versus a leader end. Nothing is silently dropped, completed to a conventional arrow or certified as letters. last_main establishes its relation to the main comma; last_note shows the complete cluster.

The marginal abbreviation is hom. The words trouve and alors are live under a long enclosure/attachment stroke crossing ascenders. A separate point after trouve gives the authored On trouve. alors. There is no point after alors or supplied closing parenthesis. The large left curve and continuing lower stroke are reproduced.

Only the conditional equivariant-fiber calculation in check_events was actually proved. It establishes fiber stability/transport under explicit assumptions, not transitivity/homogeneity, normalization profiniteness or the assertion in (19). No mathematical expectation determined a doubtful ink reading.

check_events.statement: If p:S→I is E-equivariant, then g·p⁻¹(i)=p⁻¹(g·i); a subgroup N fixing I preserves every fiber.
check_events.place: Compatibility after (20), fiber definition (21), marginal action assertion
check_events.outcome: For s∈p⁻¹(i), equivariance gives p(g·s)=g·p(s)=g·i, giving one inclusion. Apply the same argument to g⁻¹ for the reverse inclusion. If N fixes I, this becomes p(n·s)=i for n∈N, hence fiber stability. This is conditional and formal: identifying N with the written pi1 action needs the covering setup, and no transitivity or descent theorem is claimed as checked.

math_risks: The formal calculation checks stability/transport only; the handwritten homogeneity assertion needs a transitivity argument from the covering/Galois setup and was not proved here.
Profiniteness of the normalization map depends on hypotheses and constructions not fully stated on this continuation leaf; reading the assertion is not proof.
The preservation asserted in (19) depends on preceding definitions of the Kummer structure/actions. No other source pages were consulted in this assignment.
